svg.title: What is VirtualPyTest, in one image
svg.text: Any device with a screen, tested and monitored 24/7 by AI.
Real remotes, HDMI capture and verification. No per-device licenses.
Anything with a screen and a controller
Cloud device farms work too, driven as ordinary devices.
Press the real keys, see the real screen
Hosts run next to the devices, in the lab or anywhere.
The navigation tree: screens become a reusable graph
Change one screen, every test that uses it follows.
Localize and fingerprint: check the screen, not just the click
Works in any language, on any resolution.
Scripts and campaigns, with KPIs on every run
Every run keeps the video, the steps and the diff.
Monitoring that alerts the moment it breaks
Hosts, devices and system health, all in one place.
A built-in MCP server lets any AI client inspect and control a real device.
